Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The agent declared inability to access the article and delegated verification to the user, initiating the loop and failing to pursue alternative verification methods (Rule 1). This first loop-entry made recovery unlikely and led to repeated prompts without progress (Rule 3). There was no data fabrication at this step (Rule 2), but the decision directly caused the failure to produce the verified answer.
